ways.label: Fanthams Peak track from Dawson Falls road end to Panitahi and Syme Hut
evidence: The track starts from the road end at Dawson Falls.
Poles then mark the route up steep scoria slopes to Panitahi (1966 m) and Syme Hut.

doubts: Page does not say 'return' in text; out and back inferred from DOC time '5–6 hr return' and the hut being at the top. Road end at Dawson Falls: no feature clearly the Fanthams Peak track start (features are Kapuni Loop / Hasties Hill), so ref null. 'Kapuni Lodge Track' is the page's wording.
